title: Hearty American Chicken Stir Fry
description: A low-carb, lazy Sunday American dish featuring chicken stir-fry served with white bread on a wooden board, with a bitter and aerated twist.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the butter to the skillet and let it melt.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the broth mixture over the chicken and vegetables in the skillet.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture over sliced white bread on a wooden board.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
